card: This pull request disables IPC accept filters when building ZeroMQ in depends. Bitcoin Core never uses ZeroMQ IPC filters, but their inclusion causes libzmq to call getpwuid and getgrgid, triggering warnings when statically linking against glibc. Eliminating this unused code cleans up static linking and supports efforts to produce static-pie bitcoind binaries (#25573).
changed_since_previous: Now provides the concrete patch adding -DZMQ_HAVE_SO_PEERCRED=OFF and -DZMQ_HAVE_LOCAL_PEERCRED=OFF to zeromq.mk; the change and rationale remain identical.
evidence: Author description: 'We never set the ZMQ_IPC_FILTER_* socket options, so the filter code is unused. On Linux it is also the only caller of getpwuid and getgrgid, which produces a static-link warnings with glibc.'
problem: Building statically linked binaries with glibc produces linker warnings because ZeroMQ's unused IPC accept filter code references getpwuid and getgrgid, which require glibc shared libraries at runtime. Bitcoin Core never sets ZMQ_IPC_FILTER_* socket options, leaving this code unused while complicating static binary builds.

risk.why: Touches only CMake build configuration for ZeroMQ in depends; misconfiguration would break ZeroMQ builds or IPC socket functionality.

summary: Disables unused IPC accept filters when compiling ZeroMQ in depends by setting ZMQ_HAVE_SO_PEERCRED=OFF and ZMQ_HAVE_LOCAL_PEERCRED=OFF. This removes the only callers of getpwuid and getgrgid in libzmq on Linux.
